claim: If AI is about 15% of total data-centre electricity in 2024, then roughly 80-85% still powers the digital economy people already use: streaming, video calls, email, cloud storage, social feeds, enterprise software, and e-commerce.
shortLabel: Most data-centre demand is still non-AI
comparisonContext: This is the pedagogical counterweight to narratives that make data centres sound like an AI-only phenomenon.
scopeNote: There is no single authoritative share breakdown for every non-AI workload category; the broad picture is what matters here.
